title: GAIA Controller Output
description: Schema for the response produced by the GAIA Agentic Controller.

task.description: The normalized task selected by the controller.

answer.description: The final natural-language answer presented to the user.

confidence.description: A numeric confidence score for the result, normalized from 0.0 to 1.0.

evidence.description: A collection of visual or structured evidence generated by the workflow.

execution_trace.description: A structured, auditable record of the controller's observable execution.

task_selected.description: The task that the controller decided to execute.

validation_result.description: The result of validating the input request.

tools_invoked.description: List of tools or models invoked during the execution.

tool_name.description: Name of the tool or model.

parameters.description: Relevant parameters passed to the tool.

execution_status.description: The final status of this tool's execution (e.g., 'success', 'failed').

errors.description: Errors encountered during tool execution, if any.

warnings.description: Warnings encountered during tool execution, if any.

execution_status.description: The overall status of the controller execution.
